# teams_mobility_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing MobilityPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `ip_audio_mobile_mode` (String) Maps to the -IPAudioMobileMode parameter.
- `ip_video_mobile_mode` (String) Maps to the -IPVideoMobileMode parameter.
- `links_in_teams` (String) Maps to the -LinksInTeams parameter.
- `mobile_dialer_preference` (String) Maps to the -MobileDialerPreference parameter.
